name: OBELiX experimental solid electrolyte conductivity
description: Expert-curated experimental room-temperature lithium ionic conductivity with crystallographic metadata and a partial CIF collection.
count_scope: Provider README and publication benchmark; entries may share compositions.

sources.title: OBELiX author repository
sources.evidence: README reports 599 entries and 321 CIFs, with columns for original source DOI, close-match structure provenance and Liverpool/Laskowski crosswalks.

sources.title: OBELiX data licence
sources.evidence: Repository licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.

sources.title: OBELiX data availability
sources.evidence: Publication identifies v1.0.0 benchmark; 291 of 321 CIFs have added random noise.

caveats: Overlaps Liverpool and Laskowski source datasets; do not sum their material counts.
Only 321 entries have CIF files; some are close matches rather than exact structures of the measured samples.
Noise-modified CIFs and partial occupancies require care in structure-based modeling.
599 entries are not established as 599 unique chemical compositions.

name: Liverpool Ionics Dataset
description: Expert-validated AC impedance lithium-ion conductivity measurements with composition, temperature and structural-family labels.
count_scope: Original paper corpus from 214 sources, including 434 directly measured and 31 extrapolated room-temperature records.
license: Free academic/research use with attribution; commercial extraction or reutilisation requires University of Liverpool licence (provider terms)

sources.title: Liverpool Ionics primary paper
sources.evidence: Reports 820 entries from 214 sources, 434 measured plus 31 extrapolated near-room-temperature records covering 403 unique compositions; published 16 January 2023.

sources.title: University of Liverpool dataset and terms
sources.evidence: Provider page supplies table/CSV, commercial reuse conditions and an October 2024 correction for entry 703.

caveats: Structural labels are not atomic-coordinate crystal structures.
Room-temperature definition is 15–35 degrees C; 31 room-temperature records are extrapolated.
Mixture of total and bulk conductivities reflects reporting differences.
The 372-row Foundry export is a separate derivative snapshot and does not replace the full 820-entry count.
Provider endpoint failed local certificate verification; count verified from publisher and terms from indexed provider content.

additional_counts.scope: Near-room-temperature subset of original paper, not the full temperature-resolved table
434 direct plus 31 extrapolated, covering 403 unique compositions

name: Caltech experimental Li-ion structure–conductivity database
description: Experimental Li-ion conductivities joined to ICSD structure identifiers, with a separate ensemble-model prediction file.
count_scope: Experimental database in ionic_conductivity_database.csv; excludes the separate model prediction file.

sources.title: CaltechDATA provider record
sources.evidence: Describes 571 Li-containing compounds with conductivity and ICSD collection codes, and separates a predicted superionic-likelihood CSV.

sources.title: CaltechDATA machine-readable metadata
sources.evidence: Lists two CSV files and CC0 1.0 rights.

caveats: Structure identifiers do not convey redistribution rights to full ICSD coordinates.
Separate predicted superionic likelihoods must not be presented as measured conductivity.
Shares Laskowski literature lineage with other electrolyte collections; material overlap not quantified here.

name: Shon–Min text-mined ionic conductivity database
description: ChemDataExtractor-derived ionic-conductivity records with chemical names, provenance and selected solid-electrolyte family labels.
count_scope: Published extraction output; not a count of distinct materials or fully validated experimental measurements.
license: Not verified for repository data; publication and supplementary material carry CC BY-NC-ND 4.0

sources.title: Shon and Min 2023 primary paper
sources.evidence: Reports 4,924 ionic-conductivity records extracted from 1,457 of 3,258 papers; describes eight electrolyte structural-type annotations and extraction validation limits.

sources.title: Author data release
sources.evidence: README links IonicalConductivityDatabase.json and reconstructed battery data; GitHub API confirms a 7,063,926-byte JSON file.

caveats: An extraction dataset derived from the existing battery-database corpus, not an independent set of newly measured materials.
Temperature attribution and numerical extraction errors require original-paper checks; evaluation extracted 10 of 38 reference materials.
Eight structural families are labels, not atomic coordinates; the complete extracted set is not proved all crystalline or solid.
A public repository does not establish an unrestricted data licence.

name: UW CMG dilute-solute diffusion database
description: DFT vacancy-mediated solute diffusion coefficients, activation barriers and attempt frequencies across metallic crystal hosts.
count_scope: Expanded Figshare release across FCC/BCC/HCP hosts; original 2016 article described more than 230 systems.

sources.title: Expanded author diffusion release
sources.evidence: v10 describes more than 400 systems in 15 metallic hosts and provides a DFT diffusivity workbook plus experimental comparison data; metadata licence CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: UW CMG provider table
sources.evidence: Provider gives Arrhenius parameters for vacancy-mediated diffusion and distinguishes paramagnetic BCC Fe treatment.

caveats: Host-solute systems and directional coefficients are not distinct bulk crystal counts.
Uses vacancy-mediated models and host self-diffusion corrections; do not treat as direct measured diffusivity.
Expanded release overlaps the original six-host paper and existing MAST-ML educational slice; do not sum them.
Atomic-coordinate package was not verified for this table.

name: Ternary fluoride-ion battery electrode reaction pairs
description: Computed electrode reaction-pair properties including voltage, capacity, energy density and structural parent identifiers.
count_scope: All-pairs CSV; direct-reaction CSV is an overlapping subset, not additional materials.

sources.title: Primary data descriptor
sources.evidence: Data Records specifies 807 all-reaction pairs and 168 direct pairs, with code and data on GitHub and Figshare.

sources.title: Direct and indirect reaction data
sources.evidence: Metadata lists CSV columns for voltage, capacities, energy densities, MP IDs, space groups and barriers, with CC0 licence.

caveats: Counts are reaction pairs, not unique crystal materials.
Properties derive from DFT energies and transformations of upstream Simmate/Materials Project records.
Diffusion barriers are only included where available; release includes a few four/five-element pairs despite ternary label.
Economic estimates are historical study inputs, not current prices.

additional_counts.scope: Overlapping subset of the 807 all-pairs records

name: Literature-derived battery ionic migration barriers
description: Curated DFT-NEB barriers with periodic initial/final migration configurations, calculation metadata and source citations.
count_scope: Zenodo JSON file independently counted; publication reports 443 compositions and 27 structural groups.

sources.title: Migration-barrier data descriptor
sources.evidence: Reports 621 DFT-NEB barriers across 443 compositions and 27 structural groups, with initial/final configurations.

sources.title: Versioned migration-barrier archive
sources.evidence: Metadata lists CC BY 4.0 and a 9,108,391-byte JSON payload; downloaded checksum md5:878646be7126dd30175576a494b726b4 matches and array contains 621 entries.

sources.title: Live repository snapshot
sources.evidence: Public EM-COMPLETE-DATASET.json independently contains 619 entries, distinct from the 621-entry archived release.

caveats: The live GitHub and 2026 learning-paper subset contain 619 entries; retain the archive/version when reproducing 621.
621 pathways are not 621 unique materials; several systems have multiple migration paths.
Barriers are literature DFT-NEB values across different functionals and calculation settings, not measured activation energies.
Some endpoint structures were reconstructed or relaxed rather than copied from the original migration calculation.

name: Polyanion sodium cathode atomic structure and dynamics
description: Periodic DFT cathode configurations with energies, forces, magnetic moments and Bader charges for a subset.
count_scope: Combined dataset including 113,532 charge-labeled structures and 184,612 additional optimization configurations.

sources.title: DTU author release v5
sources.evidence: Release states 113,532 charge-labeled and 184,612 additional configurations, with a complete 298,144-configuration Combined.xyz; declares CC BY 4.0 and fixes charge signs in v5.

sources.title: Primary sodium cathode descriptor
sources.evidence: Covers four polyanionic cathode structure types with Fe/Mn/Co/Ni, sampling optimization, AIMD and active-learning MD configurations.

caveats: Configurations are highly correlated frames/optimization steps, not unique compounds.
Combined.xyz files and per-family/submethod files overlap; do not add all file counts.
Only 113,532 configurations have Bader charges.
MD sampling temperature is 1000 K; this is not a database of measured room-temperature conductivity.

name: Oxygen migration barriers in perovskites
description: DFT oxygen migration barriers and descriptor data for perovskite ionic conductors, with archived raw calculation data.
count_scope: Lower bound in primary publication; exact row/material count of archived workbook not independently recounted.

sources.title: Mayeshiba and Morgan primary article
sources.evidence: Authors describe ab initio oxygen migration barriers for over 40 perovskites and compare vacancy formation and oxygen-band descriptors.

sources.title: Author dataset archive
sources.evidence: v2 metadata links study DOI and provides a workbook and 4.19 GB raw-data archive, with CC BY 4.0 licence.

caveats: This is a defect/pathway property collection, not a count of measured oxygen conductivities.
Large raw-data archive was not downloaded; reusable periodic-coordinate coverage has not been inspected.
Barriers reflect specific vacancy and calculation conventions.

name: Materials Cloud fast Li-ion conductor screening
description: First-principles molecular-dynamics trajectories and periodic structures for lithium solid-electrolyte screening, with one complete AiiDA provenance example.
count_display: ~60 shortlisted FPMD candidates described; exact released structure/trajectory count not recounted
count_scope: Release includes fpmd_structures.aiida, fpmd_trajectories.aiida and one complete screening archive; the >30,000 starting structures are not the released dataset count.

sources.title: Materials Cloud author archive
sources.evidence: Release describes >30,000 source structures, ~1,000 pinball-screened insulators and ~60 FPMD shortlist candidates; includes FPMD structures/trajectories and one complete Li7NbO6 provenance archive.

sources.title: Materials Cloud release metadata
sources.evidence: Lists four public files totaling 17,645,859,671 bytes with checksums, including structures, trajectories, README and provenance; CC BY 4.0 rights.

caveats: The >30,000 source-pool size is not a count of released FPMD systems or new materials.
Pinball-model screening and full first-principles MD labels must remain distinct.
AiiDA trajectory/provenance archives total about 16.4 GiB; bulk payloads were not downloaded or counted in this survey.
Source experimental databases overlap COD, ICSD and MPDS.
